messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: connector-service error rate (timeouts) > 6% over 5m in prod-us-west. firing prom rule connector_timeout_rate.

srinivas: ack. oncall here. joining bridge now — https://meet.example.com/bridge-connector

alex: I see this spikes right after canary deploy v2026-03-15-09. can someone grab the deploy tags and pod statuses?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout detected for deployment/connector-service (rev=v2026-03-15-09).

maria: CS: 2 paying customers reported elevated latencies/timeouts in the last 10m. I've pinged them and told them we're investigating; escalated to priority.

nora: quick check: envoy metrics look like connection_pool_exhausted events. we tightened max concurrent streams in the new envoy config (PR #4399).

alex: logs from failing pods: repeated "upstream reset" + "stream closed" during bursts. pod statuses:

```
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep connector
connector-canary-1 Running 2/2  12m
connector-canary-2 CrashLoopBackOff  3m
connector-stable-3 Running 2/2  8h
```

david: that change was intentional to reduce memory per connection. looks like it reduced headroom under retries. I'll prepare an immediate rollback.

srinivas: rollback initiated for canary rev v2026-03-14. will monitor.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed for deployment/connector-service to revision v2026-03-14.

alex: metrics: timeouts dropped from 6.2% -> 0.9% over 8m after rollback. Customer impact confined to those canary pods. marking SEV=2 -> will update if wider impact seen.

maria: confirmed customers notified. offered client-side timeout workaround as temporary mitigation. all accepted.

paul: proposed follow-ups (quick list):
- postmortem + customer summary (owner: alex)
- revert envoy concurrent-streams change until validated (owner: david)
- add e2e canary stress test for stream limits (owner: nora)
- add active_streams_per_connection metric to prod (owner: david)
- adjust alerting to reduce noisy pages during short rollouts (owner: srinivas)

alex: I will own the postmortem. draft in 48h, review with eng+CS in 72h. will include timeline, root cause, customers affected, mitigation, and next steps for comms.

david: filing rollback PR now and adding a note to the deploy checklist to validate stream limits under burstier traffic.

nora: I'll add a chaos-style test to the connector suite that ramps concurrent requests and simulates retries; will land in staging this week.

srinivas: alert tuning proposal: current rule (>5% for 5m) caused paging during a short canary blip. options:
- change to >3% for 10m (catch sustained regressions) OR
- keep 5% but require for 3m with additional label grouping on deploy_revision to dedupe during rollouts
- add suppression window for alerts with deploy_revision tag for first 5m of a rollout

Example Prom snippet we can iterate on:

```
- alert: ConnectorTimeoutHigh
  expr: (sum(rate(connector_request_timeouts_total[5m])) / sum(rate(connector_requests_total[5m]))) * 100 > 5
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
    component: connector
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/connector-timeouts
```

srinivas: also proposing alert grouping keys: {service, region, deploy_revision} so we don't page multiple oncalls for the same root cause.

paul: +1. let's also add cross-region dedupe logic in the alertmanager. we paged two different rotations because of duplicated alerts.

maria: CS asks for a single, succinct customer-facing summary once the postmortem is ready. alex please include ETA for permanent fix.

alex: will include ETA (targeting config revert + tests in 1 week) and immediate mitigations (rollback, client timeout guidance).

david: noted one more gap: we don't export active_streams_per_connection in prod; I'll add that metric and a dashboard panel (owner: david).

nora: that metric will help baseline before we re-enable stricter limits. good catch.

srinivas: created tracker tasks:
- TASK-9001 postmortem draft (alex) due +48h
- TASK-9002 rollback PR (david) merged
- TASK-9003 e2e stream stress test (nora) due +5d
- TASK-9004 add metric + dashboard (david) due +3d
- TASK-9005 alert rule update in staging (srinivas) due +24h

ops-bot: TODOs created: TASK-9001, TASK-9002, TASK-9003, TASK-9004, TASK-9005

paul: final notes: consider a short quiet period suppression around canary rollouts for low-severity transient alerts, coordinate with release engineers so we don't hide real regressions.

maria: I'll track customer follow-ups and schedule a sync after the postmortem is published.

alex: closing bridge now. will post the postmortem link and customer summary here when ready. thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. duration: 00:18:12. incident id: INC-2026-03-15-connector-01
